# PX4 v1.17.0 parameters for P+C, from the flight sim (pcs14 flight-sim)
# Paste into the MAVLink console (QGroundControl, Analyze Tools), then reboot.
# The motors' outputs and DShot are set in QGroundControl's Actuators page.
param set BAT1_CAPACITY 9000
param set BAT1_N_CELLS 6
param set CA_ROTOR0_KM 0.0162
param set CA_ROTOR0_PX 0.1485
param set CA_ROTOR0_PY 0.1486
param set CA_ROTOR0_PZ -0.0391
param set CA_ROTOR1_KM 0.0162
param set CA_ROTOR1_PX -0.1485
param set CA_ROTOR1_PY -0.1484
param set CA_ROTOR1_PZ -0.0391
param set CA_ROTOR2_KM -0.0162
param set CA_ROTOR2_PX 0.1485
param set CA_ROTOR2_PY -0.1484
param set CA_ROTOR2_PZ -0.0391
param set CA_ROTOR3_KM -0.0162
param set CA_ROTOR3_PX -0.1485
param set CA_ROTOR3_PY 0.1486
param set CA_ROTOR3_PZ -0.0391
param set CA_ROTOR_COUNT 4
param set CBRK_FLIGHTTERM 0
param set MC_PITCH_P 9
param set MC_ROLL_P 9
param set MPC_THR_HOVER 0.6
param set MPC_TILTMAX_AIR 45
param set MPC_VEL_MANUAL 25
param set MPC_XY_CRUISE 10
param set MPC_XY_VEL_MAX 25
param set NAV_DLL_ACT 2
